domain: Orthodontics, Gnathology, Lateral Cephalometry (TRG), and 8-Angle Photoprotocol

defects_identified_and_eliminated.description: Header title was starved to 14px width in CephalometricAnalysisModal.tsx due to flex-1 presets bar wrapping into 1123px tower
defects_identified_and_eliminated.resolution: Relocated presets into dedicated desktop subheader strip and set modal to h-[92vh] max-h-[92vh]

defects_identified_and_eliminated.description: Undefined CSS tokens (--paper-panel) and light-theme text colors bleeding into dark radiology modal caused invisible black text on dark background in Light Mode
defects_identified_and_eliminated.resolution: Set data-theme='dark' on ceph-workstation-root, removed undefined token fallbacks, and added explicit protection styles for action buttons

defects_identified_and_eliminated.description: Tab titles '1. Ориентиры (Точки: 16)', '2. Расчет углов (Анализ)', '3. Медицинская карта' collided horizontally in 5-col sidebar
defects_identified_and_eliminated.resolution: Shortened labels to '1. Ориентиры (16/16)', '2. Расчет углов', '3. Медицинская карта' with proper truncation

defects_identified_and_eliminated.description: Tab 1 body had redundant squashed preset buttons with ellipsis ('★ I Класс (...)', 'II Класс (Дист...')
defects_identified_and_eliminated.resolution: Hidden on desktop (lg:hidden) as top horizontal strip already hosts full presets

defects_identified_and_eliminated.description: Hardcoded width: 28px in photoProtocol.css clipped Russian text 'Загрузить' into multi-line wrap
defects_identified_and_eliminated.resolution: Introduced .ortho-slot-btn-text with min-width: 28px and width: auto !important

defects_identified_and_eliminated.description: White text on white background in dark mode for card sequence badges (.ortho-slot-num)
defects_identified_and_eliminated.resolution: Set dark mode background to #334155 with #ffffff text, ensuring high contrast

defects_identified_and_eliminated.description: Six action buttons crowded on 1 row squashed 'Вставить в карту (1 клик)' vertically
defects_identified_and_eliminated.resolution: Refactored into 2-row layout (row 1: patient memo, row 2: primary actions) with 48px touch targets

defects_identified_and_eliminated.description: Residual Soviet '043/у' ciphers appeared on UI controls and diary header synthesis
defects_identified_and_eliminated.resolution: Purged per Mandate 8z in favor of clean Russian medical terminology ('Ортодонтический протокол приёма')
